mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ACT_HI_PROCINST res LEFT JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF def ON res.PROC_DEF_ID_ = def.ID_ LEFT JOIN system_users u ON res.START_USER_ID_ = CAST(u.id AS VARCHAR)
(res.START_USER_ID_ = CAST(#{userId} AS VARCHAR) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_TASKINST t WHERE t.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND t.ASSIGNEE_ = CAST(#{userId} AS VARCHAR)))
AND res.NAME_ LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.name}, '%') AND res.ID_ LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.processInstanceId}, '%') AND def.KEY_ = #{reqVO.processDefinitionKey} AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.startUserNickname}, '%')
AND res.END_TIME_ IS NULL AND res.END_TIME_ IS NOT NULL AND (res.DELETE_REASON_ IS NULL OR res.DELETE_REASON_ = 'MI_END' OR LOWER(res.DELETE_REASON_) = 'completed') AND res.END_TIME_ IS NOT NULL AND res.DELETE_REASON_ IS NOT NULL AND res.DELETE_REASON_ != 'MI_END' AND LOWER(res.DELETE_REASON_) != 'completed'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_VARINST vr WHERE vr.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND vr.NAME_ = #{VAR_PROCESS_RESULT} AND (vr.LONG_ = #{reqVO.processResult} OR vr.TEXT_ = CAST(#{reqVO.processResult} AS VARCHAR)))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_VARINST v WHERE v.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND v.NAME_ = #{VAR_SOURCE_UNIT} AND v.TEXT_ LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.startDeptName}, '%'))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_VARINST v WHERE v.PROC_INST_ID_ = res.ID_ AND v.NAME_ = #{VAR_DEADLINE} AND ((v.LONG_ IS NOT NULL AND (CURRENT_DATE - DATE(to_timestamp(v.LONG_ / 1000))) >= #{reqVO.overdueDays}) OR (v.TEXT_ IS NOT NULL AND v.TEXT_ != '' AND (CURRENT_DATE - TO_DATE(v.TEXT_, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= #{reqVO.overdueDays})))
AND res.START_TIME_ BETWEEN #{reqVO.createTime[0]} AND #{reqVO.createTime[1]}
